name: Bukki
overview: Bukki was a male leader from the tribe of Dan, appointed to help apportion the Promised Land as recorded in Numbers 34:22. His role as leader highlights his importance in the organization and division of the land among the tribes of Israel. His leadership is specifically noted in the context of the tribal allotments.
namesAndTitles: The name Bukki means 'proved of YHWH' or 'mouth [gurgle sounds] of YHWH,' reflecting a connection to God’s approval or communication. This proper name, as given in Numbers 34:22, underscores a meaningful relationship with the Lord, though it was not explicitly stated to be given by God directly.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Bukki was the father of Jogli, as stated in Numbers 34:22. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Bukki’s significance lies in his leadership role during a pivotal moment in Israel’s history—the division of the land promised by God. As the leader of the tribe of Dan tasked with apportioning the land, he contributed to fulfilling God’s covenant with Israel. His mention in Numbers 34:22 places him among those entrusted with the sacred duty of distributing the inheritance, marking him as a faithful servant in God’s plan.
